title: Rajesh Kumar vs. State of Tamil Nadu & Anr.
tamil_title: ராஜேஷ் குமார் எதிர் தமிழ்நாடு அரசு மற்றும் பலர்
court: V Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Egmore, Chennai
tamil_court: V பெருநகர குற்றவியல் நடுவர் நீதிமன்றம், எழும்பூர், சென்னை
respondent: State of Tamil Nadu (Represented by Sub-Inspector, Egmore PS)

timeline.description: Criminal complaint registered under BNS Section 318 (Cheating). Documents verified.
Case admitted by Hon'ble Magistrate. Summons ordered to Respondent.
Respondent appeared in person. Bail application filed and granted under conditions.
Charges framed under BNS 318. Accused pleaded not guilty. Commenced evidence stage.
Examination of Complainant Rajesh Kumar. Chief examination concluded, cross-examination deferred.
Scheduled for cross-examination of the complainant by defense counsel. Next step.
Presentation of evidence and witnesses by the defense team.
Closing arguments by both the Public Prosecutor and Defense Counsel.
Final order/judgment to be pronounced by the Magistrate.

title: Alpha Tech Solutions vs. Nexa Global Ltd.
tamil_title: ஆல்பா டெக் சொல்யூஷன்ஸ் எதிர் நெக்ஸா குளோபல் லிமிடெட்
court: Delhi High Court (Commercial Division), New Delhi
tamil_court: டெல்லி உயர் நீதிமன்றம் (வணிகப் பிரிவு), புது டெல்லி
judge: Hon'ble Justice Ms. Pratibha M. Singh

timeline.description: Suit filed for intellectual property infringement and breach of contract. Claim value ₹2.5 Crores.
Ad-interim injunction granted restraining defendant from using the software code.
Written statement and counterclaims filed by Nexa Global Ltd.
Admission and denial of documents completed by both parties under Commercial Courts Act.
Trial issues framed by Court. Discovery procedures initiated.
Witness affidavits filed. Commission-based cross-examinations completed and filed in court registry.
Final hearing on merits. Scheduled for oral arguments by senior counsels.
Court to reserve judgment for writing and future delivery.
Delivery of final decree and orders in open court.

title: State of Maharashtra vs. Rohan Sawant
judge: Shri. S. R. Shinde, Sessions Judge

timeline.description: FIR registered under IPC Section 307 (Attempt to murder). Accused arrested and remanded.
Police filed a detailed chargesheet with forensic reports and 12 witness statements.
Charges formally framed under IPC 307. Trial dates allocated.
Examination of doctor, eyewitnesses and IO completed. Evidence closed.
Accused statement recorded. Denied charges, claimed false implication.
Arguments concluded by both prosecution and defense.
Accused found guilty under IPC Section 307. Sentenced to 5 years rigorous imprisonment and ₹50,000 fine.
